attchmntText: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Board meeting held on today, inter alia, approving the Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 and declaration of interim dividend.
Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of the earnings conference call held for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet with institutional investors on November 18, 2026.
Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding closure of trading window from October 1, 2026 till 48 hours after declaration of Financial Results.
Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding appointment of Mr. A. Sample as Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel with effect from December 1, 2026.
Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release.
Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Financial Results.
